_topic: What is a Rave — デジタルブック第1章。レイブの本質＝一夜限りの世界・自我の溶解・PLURの約束。

slides.sub: What's left is the oldest human act — gathering to lose yourself together.
It appears for one night. Then vanishes. No address. No owner.
No VIP. No stage to worship. The DJ faces the same dark as you.

slides.note: Ego death by four-to-the-floor. This is why people cry at 4am.

slides.sub: The music is the doorway. Unity is the room.
A rave runs on an agreement — not a ticket.

slides.cta: Save this. This is chapter one.
